name: Vigor 09 · Clinician Review (Human in the Loop)

parameters.content:
## 09 · Clinician review
The gate workflow 03 waits on.

Escalating is always allowed. De-escalating needs a written justification against the clinician's id — and is **refused outright** when it crosses an emergency red flag (torsion, mass, priapism, trauma, retention).

Refused attempts are audited, so a pattern is visible.

assignments.name: vigorConfig
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = { agentServiceUrl: 'http://host.docker.internal:8000', internalToken: '', notifyMode: 'DEMO', oncallEmail: 'oncall@example-clinic.ae', escalationSlaMinutes: 60, quietHoursStart: 21, quietHoursEnd: 8, webhookBase: 'http://localhost:5678', envBlocked: true }; try { return { agentServiceUrl: $env.VIGOR_AGENT_SERVICE_URL || d.agentServiceUrl, internalToken: $env.VIGOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN || '', notifyMode: $env.VIGOR_NOTIFY_MODE || 'DEMO', oncallEmail: $env.VIGOR_ONCALL_EMAIL || d.oncallEmail, escalationSlaMinutes: Number($env.VIGOR_ESCALATION_SLA_MINUTES || 60), quietHoursStart: Number($env.VIGOR_QUIET_HOURS_START || 21), quietHoursEnd: Number($env.VIGOR_QUIET_HOURS_END || 8), webhookBase: ($env.WEBHOOK_URL || 'http://localhost:5678/').replace(/\/$/, ''), envBlocked: false }; } catch (e) { return d; } })() }}

nodes.name: Vigor config
nodes.notes: The only node that reads $env. Needs N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false, and falls back to defaults with envBlocked:true if that is missing.

nodes.name: Authenticate clinician
nodes.notes: A shared key is enough for a hackathon build; production needs the clinician's own federated identity, which is noted in docs/06-clinical-safety.md.

nodes.name: Evaluate override
nodes.notes: The one rule a clinician cannot talk their way past, enforced in code.

nodes.name: Doc · audit blocked override
nodes.notes: A refused de-escalation is a clinical-governance signal and is never silent.

nodes.name: Doc · acknowledge escalation
nodes.notes: Acknowledgement is what stops the SLA sweep in workflow 02. A breached escalation keeps its breach record and is closed, not quietly reset.
